1.title:
Snap a photo
of anything
1.text: Point the camera at anything around you. Every photo becomes a random seed waiting to sprout.

2.title:
Sow seeds
and care for plants
2.text: Plant seeds in pots, then water and feed them on time so they grow through every stage. Neglect them for too long and they will wilt.

3.title:
Collect
the whole set
3.text: Every species you meet is added to your collection. Grow it until it blooms to unlock its description, care tips and fun facts.
